widget_config.content: Click the empty canvas to plant flowers
Interactive HTML background layer (garden.html), with snow drawn over the icons from a second layer.

background_layers.name: Garden
background_layers.source:
<!-- Garden -->
<!doctype html>
<html>
	<head>
		<style>
			html,
			body {
				margin: 0;
				height: 100%;
				overflow: hidden;
				background: transparent;
				cursor: pointer;
			}
			canvas {
				display: block;
				width: 100%;
				height: 100%;
			}
		</style>
	</head>
	<body>
		<canvas></canvas>
		<script>
			// A row of flowers grows along the bottom; click empty canvas to plant
			// another where you clicked. Stems grow,
			// lean away from the pointer and bloom; hovering a bloom opens it
			// wider. The oldest flowers wilt once there are too many.
			const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas');
			const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
			const MAX_PLANTS = 40;
			const COLORS = [
				'255, 120, 160',
				'255, 200, 90',
				'150, 140, 255',
				'120, 220, 200',
				'255, 150, 90'
			];
			const plants = [];
			let width = 0;
			let height = 0;
			let last = 0;
			let seeded = false;

			function resize(state) {
				const ratio = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
				if (state.width === width && state.height === height) return;
				width = state.width;
				height = state.height;
				canvas.width = width * ratio;
				canvas.height = height * ratio;
				ctx.setTransform(ratio, 0, 0, ratio, 0, 0);
			}

			function plant(x, y, growth = 0) {
				plants.push({
					x,
					y,
					height: 60 + Math.random() * 90,
					petals: 5 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 4),
					size: 9 + Math.random() * 7,
					leaf: 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.3,
					color: COLORS[Math.floor(Math.random() * COLORS.length)],
					growth,
					lean: 0,
					open: 0,
					wilt: 0
				});
				const alive = plants.filter((p) => !p.wilt);
				if (alive.length > MAX_PLANTS) alive[0].wilt = 0.001;
			}

			window.addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => {
				if (event.button === 0) plant(event.clientX, event.clientY);
			});

			function drawPlant(p, time) {
				const grown = Math.min(1, p.growth);
				const fade = 1 - Math.min(1, p.wilt);
				const stem = p.height * grown;
				const sway = Math.sin(time * 1.3 + p.x * 0.05) * 4 + p.lean;
				const tipX = p.x + sway;
				const tipY = p.y - stem;

				ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(110, 190, 110, ${0.9 * fade})`;
				ctx.lineWidth = 3;
				ctx.lineCap = 'round';
				ctx.beginPath();
				ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);
				ctx.quadraticCurveTo(p.x, p.y - stem * 0.5, tipX, tipY);
				ctx.stroke();

				ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(90, 170, 100, ${0.85 * fade})`;
				for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
					const t = side < 0 ? p.leaf : p.leaf + 0.2;
					const lx = p.x + (tipX - p.x) * t * t;
					const ly = p.y - stem * t;
					ctx.beginPath();
					ctx.ellipse(
						lx + side * 8 * grown,
						ly,
						10 * grown,
						4 * grown,
						side * -0.6,
						0,
						Math.PI * 2
					);
					ctx.fill();
				}

				const bloom = Math.max(0, (p.growth - 0.8) / 0.4);
				if (bloom <= 0) return;
				const size = p.size * (1 + p.open * 0.6) * Math.min(1, bloom) * (1 - p.wilt * 0.5);
				ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${p.color}, ${0.85 * fade})`;
				for (let i = 0; i < p.petals; i++) {
					const angle = (i / p.petals) * Math.PI * 2 + time * 0.2;
					ctx.beginPath();
					ctx.ellipse(
						tipX + Math.cos(angle) * size,
						tipY + Math.sin(angle) * size,
						size * 0.8,
						size * 0.45,
						angle,
						0,
						Math.PI * 2
					);
					ctx.fill();
				}
				ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 235, 150, ${fade})`;
				ctx.beginPath();
				ctx.arc(tipX, tipY, size * 0.45, 0, Math.PI * 2);
				ctx.fill();
			}

			odeko.on('frame', (state) => {
				const dt = Math.min(0.05, state.time - last);
				last = state.time;
				resize(state);
				const { pointer } = state;
				if (!plants.length && !seeded && width) {
					seeded = true;
					for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
						plant(
							((i + 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.4) / 12) * width,
							height - 4,
							0.6 + Math.random() * 0.6
						);
					}
				}

				for (const p of plants) {
					p.growth += dt * 0.5;
					const tipY = p.y - p.height * Math.min(1, p.growth);
					const dx = p.x - pointer.x;
					const near = Math.max(0, 1 - Math.hypot(dx, tipY - pointer.y) / 120) * pointer.presence;
					p.lean += (Math.sign(dx) * near * 25 - p.lean) * dt * 4;
					p.open += ((near > 0.6 ? 1 : 0) - p.open) * dt * 5;
					if (p.wilt) p.wilt += dt * 0.5;
				}
				for (let i = plants.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
					if (plants[i].wilt >= 1) plants.splice(i, 1);
				}

				ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
				const ground = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, height - 60, 0, height);
				ground.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(60, 120, 70, 0)');
				ground.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(60, 120, 70, 0.35)');
				ctx.fillStyle = ground;
				ctx.fillRect(0, height - 60, width, 60);
				for (const p of plants) drawPlant(p, state.time);
			});
		</script>
	</body>
</html>

background_layers.name: Snow
background_layers.source:
<!-- Snow (set Placement to "Over icons") -->
<!doctype html>
<html>
	<head>
		<style>
			html,
			body {
				margin: 0;
				height: 100%;
				overflow: hidden;
				background: transparent;
			}
			canvas {
				display: block;
				width: 100%;
				height: 100%;
			}
		</style>
	</head>
	<body>
		<canvas></canvas>
		<script>
			// Snow falling over the icons. The pointer blows flakes away and
			// flakes that land on an icon's top edge rest there and melt.
			const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas');
			const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
			const flakes = [];
			let width = 0;
			let height = 0;

			function spawn(atTop) {
				return {
					x: Math.random() * width,
					y: atTop ? -10 : Math.random() * height,
					r: 1 + Math.random() * 2.5,
					vx: 0,
					vy: 20 + Math.random() * 30,
					sway: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
					rest: 0
				};
			}

			function resize(state) {
				const ratio = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
				if (state.width === width && state.height === height) return;
				width = state.width;
				height = state.height;
				canvas.width = width * ratio;
				canvas.height = height * ratio;
				ctx.setTransform(ratio, 0, 0, ratio, 0, 0);
				const target = Math.round((width * height) / 6000);
				while (flakes.length < target) flakes.push(spawn(false));
				flakes.length = target;
			}

			function landedOn(flake, icons) {
				for (const icon of icons) {
					if (
						flake.x > icon.x + 4 &&
						flake.x < icon.x + icon.width - 4 &&
						flake.y > icon.y - 2 &&
						flake.y < icon.y + 4
					) {
						return icon;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}

			let last = 0;
			odeko.on('frame', (state) => {
				const dt = Math.min(0.05, state.time - last);
				last = state.time;
				resize(state);
				ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
				ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85)';
				const { pointer, velocity } = state;

				for (let i = 0; i < flakes.length; i++) {
					const f = flakes[i];
					if (f.rest > 0) {
						f.rest -= dt;
						if (f.rest <= 0) flakes[i] = spawn(true);
					} else {
						const dx = f.x - pointer.x;
						const dy = f.y - pointer.y;
						const near = Math.max(0, 1 - Math.hypot(dx, dy) / 90) * pointer.presence;
						f.vx += (velocity.x * near * 0.08 - f.vx) * dt * 2;
						f.sway += dt;
						f.x += (f.vx + Math.sin(f.sway) * 12) * dt;
						f.y += (f.vy + velocity.y * near * 0.05) * dt;
						if (landedOn(f, state.icons)) f.rest = 2 + Math.random() * 4;
						if (f.y > height + 10 || f.x < -20 || f.x > width + 20) flakes[i] = spawn(true);
					}
					ctx.globalAlpha = f.rest > 0 ? Math.min(1, f.rest) : 1;
					ctx.beginPath();
					ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, f.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
					ctx.fill();
				}
				ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
			});
		</script>
	</body>
</html>
